name: @gipity/chatbot

scripts.test: bash -c 'for t in tests/*.test.js; do node $t || exit 1; done'

description: Drop-in chatbot for Gipity apps: configurable persona, scope guardrails (allowed/refused with refusal examples), static knowledge (20k token budget), streaming LLM responses, suggested-prompt chips. On install it scaffolds src/js/chatbot.config.js - edit it, then mount('#bot', config) in your page. Headless engine + bubble widget; bring your own UI if you want.
